entity_level: App / operating brand; current holding-company transaction separately identified
parent: StoryMatrix operator; Drama Times holding entity; Dianzhong origin; WEBTOON preferred-share investor
headquarters: Singapore operating headquarters; Dianzhong origin in Beijing

sections.Company & Ownership: StoryMatrix Pte. Ltd. is the Singapore operator; its July 18, 2026 policy gives a Singapore registered address. Headquarters is reported as Singapore by PitchBook; this should not be confused with Dianzhong’s Beijing base. DramaBox launched in April 2023. The ownership description changed materially in 2026: WEBTOON’s filing says Tap Future merged into Drama Times Inc. (called DramaBox in the filing) on October 8, 2026; WEBTOON received and additionally purchased Series A1 preferred shares. It does not disclose a complete post-merger cap table or valuation. Disney confirms participation in its 2025 accelerator, not a disclosed acquisition. [Operator policy](https://support.dramaboxdb.com/privacy.html), [HQ profile](https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/769498-03), [origin and launch](https://cbgl.iabchina.cn/brands/dramabox), [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1997859/000199785926000099/R26.htm), [Disney](https://sites.disney.com/accelerator/2025/07/28/disney-accelerator-announces-its-2025-class-of-companies-animaj-dramabox-haddy-and-liminal-space-join-the-portfolio-of-companies-to-participate-in-the-successful-growth-development-and-innovation/).
sections.Core Strategy & Positioning: International app distribution combines translated-origin content with localized originals. Romance, identity reversals, fantasy and revenge are visible catalog propositions. Paid creative acquisition is documented by SocialPeta; the April 26, 2026 Trade Desk partnership adds programmatic advertising demand. Do not confuse selling ad inventory with buying users: they are separate sides of the business. [Advertising research](https://sp2cdn-idea-global.zingfront.com/report-preview/2025/Insight-into-Global-Micro-Drama-App-Marketing-for-H1-2025.pdf), [partner announcement](https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/the-trade-desk-powers-open-internet-growth-with-dramabox-short-drama-partnership-302752834.html).
sections.Monetization & Unit Economics: Free entry with in-app offers, memberships and advertising. US iOS snapshot on November 21, 2026 lists memberships at $5.99, $17.99 and $19.99, but the SKU labels do not establish duration; they must not all be called weekly plans. It also lists $4.99 and $9.99 special offers. A stable universal coin exchange rate, advertising/IAP split, realized payer LTV and CAC are not disclosed in the reviewed evidence. [Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dramabox-stream-drama-shorts/id6445905219). The verified ad partnership supports a mixed model, not a quantified advertising share.

These are app-level consumer-spending estimates, not audited group revenue. Dianzhong group figures and WEBTOON investment distributions must not be attributed to DramaBox app sales.
sections.Notable Titles & IP: The inspected store promotes *Falling for the Demon Prince*, *Ugly Duckling, Hidden Beauty* and *Escape from Greystone*. These demonstrate fantasy-school, appearance/status and confinement/suspense positioning; store promotion is not title-level performance proof. The reviewed material does not provide an audited current original-production cadence. [Catalog events](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dramabox-stream-drama-shorts/id6445905219).
sections.Competitive Moat & Risks: Analyst interpretation: scale in paid distribution, a broad localized library and access to programmatic advertising can support multiple monetization paths. Risks include acquisition competition, title-rights complexity and confusing store spending with net financial results. The 2026 ownership transaction also makes static parent-company lists unreliable. This adult-oriented app research does not establish suitability or preferences for Roblox youth audiences.

judge.rationale: Operator/HQ and the latest verified holding-company transaction are explicit; two dated metrics are sourced; acquisition and advertising monetization are distinguished. Full beneficial ownership and private unit economics remain disclosure limitations.
